setup.fix.diff:
--- a/input
+++ b/input
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
-alpha
+ALPHA
 beta
\ No newline at end of file

commands.notes: Applies unified and Git diffs, including Git binary patches (literal and delta), through the hunk applier patch uses; hunks may land at an offset but need exact context. Nothing changes unless every section applies. --check, --stat, --numstat and --summary only read. Work tree files are captured before anything is written and publish through the same pinned write door as patch; a file changed after capture refuses with COMMAND_REVISION_CONFLICT. --index requires the work tree to match the index and then stages exactly the patched paths; --cached changes only the index. Index changes are one reviewed Git operation with git add's review and session-staging rules, leaving unrelated staged work alone. --3way merges a section into the current content from the preimage blob the patch names, using Git's merge-file; conflicts leave markers in the work tree and stages 1-3 in the index and report U PATH with status 1. --whitespace=warn (default) reports added lines with trailing whitespace or a space before a tab, fix strips trailing whitespace from them, error stops with status 128.

reuse.extension: Shared hunk applier in internal/tools/native/patchapply; work tree publication through the mutation owners' pinned patch targets; index changes through the Git owner's reviewed stage operation.
reuse.evidence_kind: owner tests over fixture repositories, compared with the bundled Git

Conflicts and failures report the observed repository state. Network forms gate the destination host through mediated egress and use the host's Git credential helper and proxy policy; force pushes are not supported.
